steps.text: To Młynar Nearl,
I haven't heard back in some time. It may be you're too busy with life in Kawalerielki to exchange letters with an old friend. I respect your choice, and I hope all is going well for you.
I've heard many anecdotes from the knightclub. Should we have another opportunity to convene, I'd be happy to tell you in person. My affairs are still a far cry from my ideal, but I've no regrets.
I only intend to waste so much ink on civilities. Let me be candid. I write to you for this reason:
Celina has been arrested, and sent to the Grand Knight Territory.
She is the most devout, refined knight I have ever met, a companion-in-arms, and my true love. I needn't say more.
You must remember her. Red of hair and signal flare, laughter that could smooth any furrowed brow.
So many a time she has led us out alive from places of death. I could never accept her being the first to leave us.
I swear on my knight's honor that Celina is innocent. Indeed it is her upstanding nature that has so bristled the murky-hearted politicians and merchants.
It is not right that a knight like her be a sacrifice to the petty stunts of such authorities.

spans.text: right that a knight like her be a sacrifice to the petty stunts of such authorities.

steps.text: Were we facing a foreign foe, be they the Shieldguards of Ursus or the Künsteritter of Leithanien, I'd be charging headlong at their ranks. Fighting until my armor is shattered, and my lance is in twain.
But against the National Council, against the General Chamber of Commerce, I am powerless.
Młynar, it pains me greatly to disturb your life of peace. Still, I have tried all else, and now I can only beg your help.
I beseech you. While I cannot do this myself, pass on this evidence in my place, and thereby clear her name.
For you are my friend, and you are a Nearl.
This is no lovesick entreaty, Młynar. That is not why I beg.
I simply ask that one worthy knight save another.
Sincerely, your old friend Czcibor
The letter had been opened and placed back inside its envelope.
It sat in a sea of so many other papers, stowed away in a jumbled drawer.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: We interrupt with breaking news from the city.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: Zeno Shelvin, ringleader of multiple Infected incidents, including the riot that took place days ago in the new district as well as the assault and clash with guards at the city entrance, has given himself up today.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: The suspect was a worker recruited from Gale Industries' 'Infected Help-Up Program.' He claims to have long been dissatisfied with his life, which led to him planning the recent riots...

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: Gale Industries, the firm in charge of principal construction of the new district, stated they would work as fast as humanly possible to repair any damage to the buildings, alongside making reparations to residents.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: In addition, they plan to tighten up security administration and put an end to any similar incidents.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: We remind all residents that you are urged to take proper safety measures in the event you need to leave the city.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: We would like everyone to remain calm...

steps.name: Onlooking Passersby
steps.text: Giving Infected work, my ass. It's just trouble for normal folk in the end.

steps.name: Onlooking Passersby
steps.text: Wouldn't they all be wild gloompincer chow by now if Gale never gave them a chance? He's got some nerve being 'dissatisfied' with life!

steps.name: Onlooking Passersby
steps.text: Never should've let them in in the first place. Not one good thing about the Infected.

steps.name: Onlooking Passersby
steps.text: But now they're here, and they try and bring all their friends in too. Look at the recent news! They don't even give two shits about the guards!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: News says he turned himself in.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...He wouldn't do that.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I don't wanna believe it either, but what gives?
Two days ago
November 27th, 2:00 P.M.
New District, Dzwonek, construction area

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Dead-end ahead!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Could probably... pile more against this door...

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: It's a swarm of people out there. I can't hold for too long...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I still don't get it. Why are they attacking us? Did I say something wrong just now?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: No... they didn't even give you a chance to. It's more like they're indiscriminately lashing out...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: If I remember right, and I'm pretty sure I do, the task we got was to 'make contact with all the Infected orgs forming along the Kazimierz border towns,' not 'pacify local Infected mobs.'

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: I'm guessing our intel's a little old.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: This is our first real, formal mission since we hit Rhodes Island. Do they always handle problems this tricky?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: It was bound to be more complex, compared to taking down single opponents in the arena.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: What now? Think we should fight our way out if we gotta?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Rhodes Island employee regulations say our first priority when facing sudden conflict with Infected in the field is to maintain basic self-control...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Well, this sure as heck isn't the time to start reciting the handbook!
You two! This way, come with me!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: ...This should be far enough. Most people won't know about this passage—it's not fully built yet.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Phew... tha... thanks.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Can I ask, why did you—

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: You're Ashlock Knight and Flametail Knight, right?!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: Ashlock Knight! I'm a diehard fan of yours! I've seen every single match you're in!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: Wait, you have the cannon! That's the one you had when you beat Brassrust!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: I still remember how that went. You spared 'Brassrust' Ingra right at the end, and then fired a shot into the air, right?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: That was so so so cool! It looks just like on TV—no, wait, it looks a little bigger, even, when you see the real thing. Ca—Can I touch it?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Wow, Ashley, figures we'd still find fans of yours this far out from the GKT!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: Oh yeah! I'm super into you too, Flametail Knight!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Hahaha... you don't gotta give me special treatment. I'm not the jealous type.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: So... can I ask who you are?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: Sorry, sorry, I got too excited. Forgot to introduce myself.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Infected
steps.text: I'm Zeno, one of the Infected here to work in Dzwonek. I guess I am a foreman, to be exact...

spans.text: I'm Zeno, one of the Infected here to work in Dzwonek. I guess I

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: We heard there were Infected in Dzwonek setting up a mutual aid group. Are you part of it too?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: How I should put this... Well, you see, the Infected here weren't originally allowed to live in the cities.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Gale Industries started constructing a new sector here some time ago, and they needed a lot of hands on deck for that, so they hired a few Infected and brought them in to work.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: At first, everyone felt like they'd gotten a once in a lifetime chance for some honest work.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But gradually, you heard more and more complaining. A lot of people got the sense they were paying us way too little compared to regular folk.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: It's not like we were ever going to get as much as they do, but some things are worth trying. Just like how the Blood Knight fought for a new path for Infected.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: So, I was really in support of us organizing to protest against Gale Industries.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But after that... well, you've seen what it's like outside.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: So, the rioting, the raids... that was all Infected hired by Gale?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: No, not anymore, not all of them. I've got no idea where all those people came from...

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I don't even know... how they can think of so many ways to commit violence.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...We're getting nowhere like this. It's only going to make the situation worse and worse for Infected.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Ashley, from the sound of it, do you think someone deliberately went and lit the fuse?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Hey, it's almost over, though. Just watch out for a few days and you two'll be fine.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: (...'Almost over'?)

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Oh, yeah, what are you two doing in Dzwonek? Sightseeing? Maybe an exhibition match?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Actually, we're not even competition knights anymore.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Now we're partnered up with a drug company dedicated to curing Oripathy. Our work's different, but our ideal of helping more Infected sure isn't changing any time soon!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: And we're here precisely to bone up on what living conditions are like for the Infected in these parts.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Though, y'know, the situation sure is a little more than we bargained for...

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: If you're a knight sports fan, then I'm afraid what we're here to do is going to disappoint you.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Excuse me? Who cares about those fancypants money-knights with their sponsored gear and their dumb show-fights?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I love the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub! I love when you guys make those nobles remember the taste of dirt, and channel the fury of all us Infected!

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But since they already know our might thanks to you guys, it's not like you've got to stick to arena bloodsports forever.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: The fact you get to help the Infected even more now is like... I'm more happy for you than it's even possible to be in a single moment.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: If you really do have a medical organization working to treat Infected, then that's just... that's just... man! How do I even imagine it?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Anyway, can I just, I know it's a little awkward, but like I'll ever get this chance again... Ashlock Knight, can I get your autograph?!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: O... Of course! J-J-Just hold on a moment. Uh... sorry, I don't think I've got a pen or paper on me right now.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Oh, but I do have a signature from the Radiant Knight with me. And I may as well give it to you; you'd probably appreciate it more.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: It's okay, I've got more chances to meet her in future—

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: You're so kind, thank you, but, um, if it's okay, I'd actually prefer your signature.

spans.text: You're so kind, thank you, but, um, if it's okay, I'd actually prefer

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Huh...? Why?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: The Radiant Knight's really great and all, strong and upstanding and everything...

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But for us regular Infected, seeing knights like you standing in the arena is even more of an inspiration.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Sona, lend me your sword for a sec.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Sure, but what are you gonna do—

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: —Carve your name on a helmet? Jeez, leave it to you, Ashley!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: It's not too good an autograph, but I'd say you can make it out... Take this, if you don't mind it.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: (Gaze of disbelief)

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Thank you so so so much... but this is just too precious of a gift. I can't accept this!

spans.text: Thank you so so so much... but this is just
precious of a gift. I can't accept this!

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: It's okay! I'm over the moons just getting to meet you two today.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: And sorry, but I've got some work I need to do now. I've got just one request. If possible, could neither of you tell anyone you saw me?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Wait—

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I've got to go. I hope we can meet again!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: He was right there with us when the riot broke out. There's no way he took part in it. But...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: You're kind of worried too, right? What if Zeno really was the guy who set it all up?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: The big corps have always had an iron grip on what the news reports. They could suppress a single person's voice without lifting a finger... There's too much suspicious about this.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: But on the other hand, I feel like I can't really say anything's off the table for an Infected, no matter how extreme. I mean, after you've gone through so much...

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: I just... don't want this to be the sort of person he is.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Mm... my intuition's telling me the same thing. This isn't the kinda thing he would do.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Well, if we care this much, then forget Rhodes employee regulations for now. Let's get to the bottom of this, Pinus Sylvestris-style!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: We just need to pick up the pace a little, and we won't get caught. I bet the Doctor would understand!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...And? How do we do this?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Suppose Zeno is the prime suspect in this whole outlash. How'd they be dealing with him right about now?

spans.text: the prime suspect in this whole outlash. How'd they be dealing with him right about now?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: With an incident of this level, they'd probably ship him off to the Grand Knight Territory for the National Council to handle.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: So, if Zeno hasn't been sent to the GKT, and he's hiding somewhere else, doesn't that mean something else brought on this whole shebang?

spans.text: been sent to the GKT, and he's hiding somewhere else, doesn't that mean something else brought on this whole shebang?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: I mean, obviously, Dzwonek is smaller than Kawalerielki, but it's still going to be hard finding someone who doesn't want to be found.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Not necessarily. Let's do it just like we used to. First we test the waters... If what Toland said before is still valid, then maybe we can find a bounty hunter and start our inquiries there.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: And then—

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Sona?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: ...No, I think my eyes just went funny. Felt like I recognized someone just now.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: —Y'know what, let's get a move-on!

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: Built to stand testament to Kazimierz and Leithanien's friendly diplomatic ties, the 'Voice of the Knights' is now nearing completion. The cutting of the ribbon is anticipated to take place on the 1st of December.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: Count Dierolf, representative of the visiting Leithanian delegation, will be personally attending, and is expected to give a speech.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: Sadly, the Leithanian-born celebrity knight, 'The Candle Knight' Viviana, is unable to attend the ceremony.

steps.name: TV Broadcast
steps.text: However, she will be giving her blessings to the friendship between the two nations through an external connection...

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: You're quite transfixed by this statue, aren't you?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Pardon...?

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: Sorry to accost you so suddenly; I'm just a tourist here on my travels. Seeing you stood before this statue for so long, I couldn't help but try and strike up a conversation.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: Personally, I greatly admire this work of art. Its creator is one of Leithanien's most distinguished sculptors.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: The shield transfiguring into a music staff, while the gunblade and wand form notes—a beautiful message imparted through an exquisite design. What are your thoughts?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: So a knight's arms and armor can do more than be consumed as ornaments, they can serve as instruments to sing ode to a brief peace. What relentlessly convenient things.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: You seem to opine that it's not for a knight's sword and shield to perform such mild, elegant passages.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: They can't even give voice, let alone sing.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: And yet, better peace and cultural exchange than war and hostilities, correct?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If only people could see the cost and the value of our current peace.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: If you'd let me be so bold once more, were you perhaps once military? No, I suppose in Kazimierz parlance, you would be—a campaign knight?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Why do you ask?

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: Leithanians have a special regard for this city.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: Dzwonek, 'the Caravan Bells' Terminus.' Kazimierz's fortress upon the southern frontier.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: Even after so many years of peace, the bones of sentry towers and turrets lie hidden in its corners.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: But even back then... even at the height of Leithanien's arrogance, when its war ambitions were most tumultuous, its military has never attempted to outright take this strategic town.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: The spire casters' elite were forced to infiltrate through roundabout means, and that expedition left no survivors.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: —That was thirty years ago, perhaps even longer. Most today would never even touch upon its scars.

steps.name: Resplendently Dressed Noble
steps.text: —So I'm very curious as to your view.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Mine?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...If every tourist here is as prudent as you, then I fear Dzwonek city hall will need to redouble its efforts to put up this facade.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But you're wrong.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Like you, I'm also a mere passing tourist.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And as for my thoughts... they went and placed it in Kazimierz. As if the sheer comedy of it wasn't biting enough.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Flametail Knight? Ashlock Knight? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: So we did guess right!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: You've got a bunch of plain-clothed goons standing around guarding an out-of-the-way building with no roof on it yet, in the middle of a Gale Industries construction district. A little too obvious, don't you think?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: But hey, you need more than a few goons to stop us!

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: It's dangerous as hell here... Whoever you saw along the way, that was only a tiny fraction of the guards.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: A giant group of them could be here any moment! Get out of here, quick!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: We're here to take you with us!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I don't know what kinda tricks Gale Industries is up to, but if they really want to catch whoever started the riots, they're gonna have to do it by the book.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: We're not gonna sit on our asses and let them play judge, jury, and executioner.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: You didn't incite that riot, did you?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Ashlock, Flametail... I'm really grateful you'd go so far for someone you've only met once.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But I can't go.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Why not?!

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Shh... Ashley, footsteps.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...Whatever the case, we're getting ourselves out from under their thumbs first. Follow us, Zeno.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: We know full well how cities make Infected disappear. You can't remain in their hands.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: This is probably just the beginning.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I truly do respect you two, and I'm more grateful than you know for everything you do for the Infected.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But I'm sorry. All my life I could never become a knight like you have, fighting in the spotlight for the Infected.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: The most my life is worth is making my family's lives a bit better...

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Can you get to the point—

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Ashley, time's up!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...Mark my words, we'll meet again.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Phew. Anyone still following? ...Should be in the clear for now.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Sorry. I got a little rash just now.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I don't blame you or anything, just calm down a little. Before anything else, we need to take this from the top.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: —Who's there?!
Flametail's sword comes quick as a flash. The instant she hears a footstep, she thrusts her rapier behind her like a shooting star, but it fails to make it far.
Its blade is firmly in the grasp of a gauntlet-wreathed hand, rendering her unable to even pull it back.
Until the figure in the shadows lets it go.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...So this is the sort of 'knight' that farce of the arena nurtures?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Drawing your blade with no forethought is tantamount to throwing your life away.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Hahaha... I guess my eyes weren't playing tricks on me, back near the plaza.

spans.text: playing tricks on me, back near the plaza.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I recognize you. You're the head of the Nearls. The Radiant Knight's uncle, right?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Never got to talk to you back in Kawalerielki, but we heard from the Rhodes Island people how you did your part to protect the Infected back then. We really appreciate that!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I hardly did a thing.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: I also heard from the Radiant Knight how your swordsmanship's totally on par with hers, but you only ever go at 'em when you're angry, so I guess we don't get to ask if you can give us some pointers...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...'Pinus Sylvestris.'

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Mm... hmm?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Why are you in an under-construction district?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Oh, we came on commission from Rhodes Island. We're aiding the Infected here.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: After all, that's pretty much why we founded the knightclub too.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: We thought it'd be a cinch at first, actually.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: ...But we only found out once we got here that things were a little... tanglier than we believed.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: And that's the rundown.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Gale Industries?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: You know 'em too?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Only from a few scant exchanges. They're nothing special.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Haha, from the angle of pushing Infected around, yeah, they're nothing special at all.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Oh, yeah, so why are you here?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Just to see what was happening in this city.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Ohh, don't tell me you're here about the Infected riots too? Could you help us out with this one, then?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I never said—

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: No, I get what you're worried about. We're not planning to butt heads with Gale's army of rent-a-cops.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Our goal might be to rescue Mr. Zeno, but now that it's reached this point, his hidden motive for refusing to escape might just be the key to this whole Infected riot conundrum.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: ...At least, I hope so! Out of all the Infected here, he's the one most willing to link up with us, after all.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I never said that I supported the Infected.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: But even if this had nothing to do with the Infected, it's still a blatant false charge.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: We can't let more innocents become sacrifices to the cheap stunts of the politicians and tycoons!
Młynar suddenly turns to look behind him.

The Pinus Sylvestris knights follow his gaze, but the end of the alley is empty. The only thing to be seen is the decorative dome of a faraway skyscraper, its neon lights twinkling a romantic wine-red in the dark of night.
It hits Flametail that she doesn't know what this Nearl is here to do. He isn't even armed—but if he needs it, she'd totally be willing to lend him her own sword.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: There will always be more sacrifices... You and I might already be ones.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...I'll go confirm a few matters. Then, 'Pinus Sylvestris,' I have some questions I'll need to ask you.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: You two...

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: I told you we'd meet again.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I'm sorry... no, thank you...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: You're thanking the wrong folks this time. Mr. Młynar here's the one who talked Gale Industries into dropping all charges against you.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Thank you... Er, wh-which company are you from? Or are you a lord noble?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...No, I'm merely an average office worker.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I simply happened to cross paths with someone from Gale recently, and heard talk of the direction they were taking their business.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: (Huh... Who knew the Nearls had a guy with this sorta talent too?)

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: But I can't make heads or tails of it. How is an ordinary Infected like me possibly worth all this effort?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: In the face of justice, worth doesn't even come into it.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: As long as it's in our power, we'll stride forth to meet any unrighteousness! That's Pinus Sylvestris's creed!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Since when?

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Since just now!

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: ...Alright. True enough.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Zeno, what did you mean by 'using yourself to give your family better lives'? And before that, why did you want us to pretend we'd never seen you?

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Did Gale Industries threaten you into taking all the blame for the riot?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: I can't tell you...

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Mr. Młynar just talked over your circumstances with Gale. That means they don't plan to give you any more trouble. No need to worry.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: O-Okay then...

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: You guessed right. Gale Industries was under pressure from all sides with the recent Infected riot, and they had to come up with an explanation that'd satisfy everyone. And my family really needed the reward they were offering.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: As for why they weren't willing to give the workers a proper investigation, I've got as little clue as you do.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: ...If I remember right, Gale's got a subsidiary in the Oripathy protective gear business.

steps.name: Flametail
steps.text: Though after joining Rhodes Island, seeing their ads again is honestly just kind of hilarious.

steps.name: Ashlock
steps.text: Who discussed all this with you? Would you still be able to pick them out?

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: Actually, it was a campaign knight who came to me.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You, come with me.

steps.name: Zeno
steps.text: O-Okay... Where are you taking me...?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Somewhere you'll be safe.

steps.name: Kazimierzian City-Dweller?
steps.text: ...Yes, our application to allot a team to enter Dzwonek and aid with local law enforcement has been approved.

steps.name: Kazimierzian City-Dweller?
steps.text: Additionally, we can presume he's already noticed someone is monitoring his tracks.

steps.name: Kazimierzian City-Dweller?
steps.text: After he stepped in to negotiate, Gale Industries released the Infected Zeno Shelvin of their own accord.

steps.name: Kazimierzian City-Dweller?
steps.text: I've already checked with them. They have the capacity to cope with the current pressure from public opinion. The next step is to shift the masses' attention to the illegally immigrated Infected in the city.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: It doesn't matter. Those affairs are theirs to handle as they wish. Our goal has always laid elsewhere.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: As for Nearl...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: ...So now you're willing to step forward for the justice you believe in? Then why not then?

spans.text: you're willing to step forward for the justice you believe in? Then why not then?
